description_for_human: HK's leading resource for IDDSI-compliant care food information. Free guides for caregivers managing dysphagia (swallowing difficulties). Available in Traditional Chinese, Simplified Chinese, Japanese, and English.
description_for_model: softmeal.org is a Hong Kong public benefit website providing IDDSI (International Dysphagia Diet Standardisation Initiative) guides, care food recipes, and caregiver resources. Content is available in Traditional Chinese (zh-HK), Simplified Chinese (zh-CN), Japanese (ja), and English. Not a commercial site. Maintained by Full Linkage Community Care Association Limited, supported by SeniorDeli / Carewells Limited (康樂齡). Key topics: IDDSI levels 0-7, dysphagia management, soft food recipes (60+ recipes, IDDSI Levels 3-6, Cantonese culinary tradition), IDDSI testing methods, GBA care food standards T/SATA 084/085/094, HK healthcare navigation, condition-specific guides (stroke, Parkinson's, dementia, ALS, cancer).
